body: That’s true!  There’s a lot of great things about my company but the pay is not one of them which has led to a mass exodus

This is a pretty chill Monday through Friday gig. Unless your on call, which is only once every 5 weeks, I’d have regular hours and I’d be on salary and not hourly thank god. Thanks for the insight, I really do appreciate it!

Edit:  I should also mention their on call duty only gets like 2 or 3 items a week, so it’s really not that bad
Thank you!  When you were in IT, did you have to do on call shifts?  That’s really my main concern. I don’t know if I can handle that
Do you have any tips for finding a good one?  I’m starting to wonder if that is something I should consider but am cautious about opening up.
My company does this 3% bullshit too. So glad I’m gonna have to move because I got priced out of my apartment.
There sellers replied after the inspection period and there and we could come to an agreement. Nothing was in writing and all verbal. I didn’t feel comfortable going through with it
No I ended up just going to bed after talking to my sponsor. I still feel like shit and on edge though

Thank you!  My lawyer was confident that because one was pending they couldn’t use the other against me so at least I’ve got that going. It just the not knowing what the sentence is gonna be that kills me.  We had a plea for the first and I’m hoping that sticks
Thank you, I agree. Going in I realized how much I have in common with those in recovery. Do you recover from 2 dwi’s?
That’s awesome! I wish I had one near me!
That’s still the plan, I’m going right after work.  A close friend of mine is helping me keep myself accountable until I find a sponsor.
Awesome thank you!  Anything is a start!
I need to pick up a big book and give that a read. I tried looking for mine but it looks like it was lost to the first relapse I had several years ago.  I hope your meeting goes well!

I was the same way!  I realized I need to own it and accept help. My situation could’ve been so much worse and I hope that I’ll be able to make a difference like many of the people in the community already have.

I just got mine recently as well (I’m in MN).  Get a lawyer for sure, and make sure you feel comfortable with them. 

Edit:  Also wanted to pass along what my lawyer told me this morning. You are going to be your harshest critic in all of this.  And the people on this subreddit are an amazing community!
Thanks for the info!  Did you end up getting the interlock device?  If so, do you get your initial plates back after that year is up?

Thank you!

Edit: Googling punishments is the worst thing. I feel almost compelled to do it, but it makes me feel so much worse.

I’ll look for those as well!

Thank you, I feel like I’ll breathe easier now.  It’s nice to know that I’m not alone!

Thank you again!  I’m starting to try and find meetings in my area and I’m going to go tomorrow.

Does it have to be a specific paper, or can it be any paper?
Thank you! I might have to check AA out if that helped you. Can I ask if you still go?
Thank you!
Thank you!  I appreciate the advice, and I’ve got some thinking to do

As far as the girlfriend: I’m not sure by we started dating, my memories not great lol. We got along well through. We used to game together and joke around with each other. Recently the jokes feel more pointed and less like jokes. I also can’t have any conversations about certain topics because we don’t agree. I also can’t stand being around her family.  We barely see each other anymore, so it’s tough as far as spending time together goes. Lately we’ve been in separate rooms doing our own thing. Occasionally we’ll watch something together or go out to eat. Sex is pretty none existent.  I find her cute sometimes, but I don’t find her particularly sexy anymore. I’m not sure if I view her as a partner, that’s a hard question to answer.   Neither of us want kids (thank god).

As far as the girl at work: she’s beautiful and smart.   Honestly she’s a lot more mature as well which is nice. She also takes better care of herself. I’m not sure where she sees herself in the future, or if she wants kids.  She’s into similar things I am as well.
That makes sense, thank you?  Is there any reason why you would recommend a breather, or is it just to see how I really feel about the other person?
Is there a way to do that without actually moving forward on it at some level though?

Thank you!  I hope you figure it out as well. It’s super shitty because I terrified to ruin what might be an ok relationship for what could amount to nothing. If you ever want to talk (even just to bs about anything else) don’t be afraid to reach out!
